The plate is about 355 px across. If it is a ~26 cm dinner plate, that is about 13.7 px per cm.

The pizza slice measures roughly 200 px along its long diagonal, from (280,250) to (478,228), which is about 14.5 cm. Its width is about 110 px, or 8 cm. That gives a rectangular piece of about 14 x 8 cm, and the thickness looks like 1.5 cm.

A piece this size has a volume of roughly 14 × 8 × 1.5 ≈ 170 cm³. Pizza dough is airy, so I assume a density of about 0.5 g/cm³, which gives roughly 85-100 g. It looks like a thin, focaccia-style margherita square with basil.

At about 2.7 kcal/g, 100 g comes to roughly 270 kcal.
